fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
An alert for each new order

The app sends you an email or Slack alert when an order comes in, with the pickup date and size on the first line. A reminder goes to the customer the day before pickup.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Call-backs for every nut allergy order

Hazelbrook Bakehouse bakes almond cakes on a shared bench, so its form never confirms a nut allergy order by itself. When Dev Raman ticks a tree nut allergy for a Saturday birthday cake, the order button becomes a call-back request. Owner Marisol Ybarra gets it by email and calls him before accepting.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { weddingCakes: "Build a wedding cake order form for my cake studio. Ask the couple for their guest count and suggest a cake size from my chart, like three tiers serving 150 for 140 guests. Price it at $6 a serving and show the quote before they book a tasting. Let them pick a flavor and filling for each tier.", birthdayCakes: "Build a birthday cake order form for my bakery. Customers choose a size and flavor, type the message to pipe on top with a 30 character limit, and upload a photo of the design they like. Put each order on a decorator ticket that shows the message exactly as typed, next to the photo.", allergyRequests: "Build a cake order form for my bakehouse. We bake almond cakes on the same bench as everything else, so if a customer ticks a tree nut allergy, replace the order button with a call-back request. Email me the request with their phone number, and keep the order unconfirmed until I call them.", deliveryOrders: "Build a cake order form for my cake shop with pickup or delivery. Delivery is $20 within 10 miles, plus $2 for each mile beyond 10. Ask for the venue address and its distance, add the delivery fee to the cake price, and show the total before the customer sends the order." };
